channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: É chegada a hora de uma Advocacia Pública autônoma
item.description: The article advocates for the autonomy of the State Public Defense as an essential institution to Justice and the functioning of Brazilian democracy, highlighting the role of prosecutors in converting political decisions into legally safe acts. The 1988 Federal Constitution recognized Public Defense as part of the Brazilian State, alongside the Public Ministry and Public Defender's Office, with missions of judicial representation and legal advice to federative units. The text emphasizes the importance of the Public Ministry and State Public Defense in ensuring the legality and efficiency of government actions, reinforcing the need for autonomous institutions to consolidate Brazilian democracy.

item.title: Campanha avalia que atos dão fôlego a Lula e aposta na 6x1 para furar bolha
item.description: Lula's campaign assesses that recent protests gave momentum to the ticket but have not yet reached undecided or independent voters. Allies believe the approval of the PEC ending the 6×1 scale could help expand support. Despite grassroots mobilization, internal readings indicate the core base remains insulated within its existing support bubble.

item.title: Tanto Lula quanto Flávio vão precisar do apoio de Gilmar Mendes no STF para governar, diz constitucionalista
item.description: According to Rubens Glezer from FGV, both Lula and Flávio will need Gilmar Mendes' support at the STF to govern. The Court may make concessions to the future government to avoid minister impeachments.

item.title: Com liberação de Moraes, Flávio visita Jair Bolsonaro em casa após 90 dias
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes authorized Flávio Bolsonaro to visit his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, after 90 days of prohibition. The meeting will take place in Brasília before Flávio's campaign events in São Paulo. Moraes kept the ban on electoral political acts during the meeting.

item.title: Em busca de ampliar eleitorado, Lula vai anunciar medidas para MEIs
item.description: The Lula government is preparing measures for individual micro-entrepreneurs (MEIs) and Simple National companies, including new credit lines and debt reduction, aiming to increase support from this segment before the second round. Among the proposals is the expansion of the turnover limit for MEI enrollment, which is stalled in the Chamber. The announcement seeks to bring the president closer to an electorate resistant to the PT.

item.title: Ministro de Lula já conversa com sucessor em eventual governo Flávio
item.description: A sensitive minister in Lula's administration has already started talks with a potential successor in a possible Flávio Bolsonaro government, according to a column. The contact aims to ensure a peaceful transition, driven by polling data.

item.title: 2º turno: canal pró-Lula e programa "mudo" de Flávio mantêm TSE sob pressão
item.description: In the final stretch of the runoff, the TSE faces pressure from both Flávio Bolsonaro and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's campaigns. The court must rule on the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel while investigating the audio-less broadcast of Flávio's electoral program. Lula criticized the removal of André Janones' channel, accusing the TSE president of bias, while Flávio questioned alleged irregularities without naming direct culprits. Additionally, the TSE ordered the removal of a digitally manipulated video shared by Flávio's allies, linking a Chilean protest image to a pro-Lula event.

item.title: Flávio terá de equilibrar agro com EUA e China, diz Tereza Cristina
item.description: Tereza Cristina states that if elected, Flávio Bolsonaro will need to balance agricultural negotiations between China and the United States, considering Brazil's interests. She highlights China as the largest buyer of Brazilian agricultural products and the US as the world's largest market, suggesting that Flávio's government would follow a balancing policy similar to that of the Bolsonaro administration. Cristina also attributes recent trade tensions to Donald Trump's tariff policy.

item.title: TSE: Kassio se reúne com equipes de Flávio e Lula após batalha de decisões
item.description: TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques scheduled a meeting with the campaign teams of Flávio Bolsonaro and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva to discuss judicial decisions and the suspension of the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel created by André Janones. The meeting aims to maintain calm before the October 25th election runoff.

item.title: O movimento contra o voto feminino – no Brasil e no mundo - O Assunto #1823
item.description: The podcast O Assunto discusses the anti-feminist movement seeking to restrict women's voting rights, focusing on ultra-conservative discourse in the US and its impact in Brazil. Guests analyze the ideological origins of this movement and its expression in Brazilian politics, particularly during elections. The debate includes criticism of conservative lawmakers and feminist resistance to rights setbacks.

item.title: Semana terá duas pesquisas eleitorais presidenciais para o 2º turno; veja quando saem Quaest e Datafolha
item.description: Two presidential election polls for the 2026 runoff will be released this week: Quaest on Wednesday (14th) and Datafolha on Thursday (15th). Quaest, commissioned by Globo and O Globo, interviews 2,154 people between October 10-13, with a margin of error of two percentage points. Datafolha, hired by Folha de S.Paulo, surveys 2,520 respondents between October 13-15, also with a two-point margin of error.

item.title: Flávio pede que eleitores corram mais riscos nas redes sociais
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) urged supporters to post on social media despite possible profile bans, during a live broadcast 13 days before the runoff. His campaign judicially challenged the WhatsApp channel 'Exército do Lula', but the suspension was overturned by the electoral general counsel. The case involves André Janones (Rede-MG) and digital mobilizations from both sides of the electoral race.

item.title: Nunes Marques suspende jornal de sindicato favorável a Lula
item.description: TSE minister Kassio Nunes Marques ordered the suspension of a Sindipetro Unificado journal following pressure from Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, which alleged irregular electoral propaganda funding in favor of Lula. The union had printed 30,000 copies with pro-Lula arguments, violating electoral laws. The ruling includes a fine of 10,000 BRL for non-compliance.

item.title: Programa de Flávio promete 'tesouraço' na censura enquanto pede bloqueio de perfis ligados a Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) government plan calls for a "scissors-cut on censorship," yet his campaign has been removing content from opponents on social media, including profiles linked to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The contrast between anti-censorship rhetoric and pre-campaign actions raises questions about freedom of expression and the strategic use of digital platforms.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro supera votos do pai em todas as rendas, e Lula cresce entre mais ricos
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro received more votes than his father Jair Bolsonaro across all income brackets, while Lula lost votes in nearly all income segments, except the top 4% who showed growth. Lula's campaign shows disparate impacts in the voter base, with greater losses among the middle class.

item.title: Duda Salabert pede ao MP apuração de vídeo de Nikolas com crianças
item.description: Duda Salabert requested MP-MG to investigate Nikolas Ferreira's video featuring children criticizing Lula and electoral campaign. The children discuss public security and prices without evidence of corruption allegations. Duda questions production conditions and child protection.

item.title: Deputados do PT pedem ao STF investigação de Nunes Marques
item.description: PT lawmakers request STF investigation into Minister Kassio Nunes Marques over corruption, money laundering, and misconduct allegations, citing suspected ties to Banco Master. The filing includes messages and votes linking the judge and his associates to financial dealings involving the bank.

item.title: Site da Ancine sofre ataque hacker com mensagens contra Lula e ataques a nordestinos
item.description: The Ancine website was hacked on Monday afternoon, displaying political messages supporting Flávio Bolsonaro and opposing Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, along with attacks against Northeast residents and praise for the Southern region of Brazil, the US, and Israel. The content was removed and the site is temporarily offline.

item.title: TSE manda Flávio, Carlos e Marçal removerem vídeo falso sobre drogas em ato do PT em SP
item.description: TSE minister Marco Aurélio Bellizze ordered candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) to remove a false video from his profile that falsely accused someone of using cocaine during a pro-Lula demonstration on Paulista Avenue. The ruling also involved Carlos and Marçal, who shared the content. The video was deemed electoral disinformation.

item.title: Se perder, Lula pode indicar ministro ao STF e tentar tirar vaga de Flávio
item.description: Supreme Court justices are pressuring Lula to appoint a justice to the STF even if he loses the 2026 election, with names like Rodrigo Pacheco and Jorge Messias under consideration. The strained relationship between Lula and Pacheco, following the loss in Minas Gerais, hinders a consensual appointment, while Jair Bolsonaro's ally Jorge Oliveira could be named by Flávio Bolsonaro using his quota. The scenario reflects post-election political leverage to influence the Court's composition.

item.title: Quaest: Flávio tem 50% e Lula, 40% no DF no segundo turno
item.description: The Quaest poll released on Monday (12) shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading with 50% and Lula (PT) at 40% in the Federal District in the second round. Blank and null votes total 6%, with 4% undecided.

item.title: O dilema de Flávio ao visitar Jair Bolsonaro na prisão domiciliar
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro resumes visits to his father Jair Bolsonaro under house arrest, an opportunity to strengthen electoral alliance but risking judicial conflicts. Minister Moraes authorized the visits after a 90-day ban, requiring caution to avoid political statements from the former president.

item.title: Análise de urnas desafia tese de que abstenção tirou votos de Lula no primeiro turno
item.description: Fábio Vasconcellos's analysis debunks the claim that voter abstention caused Lula's loss of votes in the 2026 first round. Despite abstention varying only 0.14 percentage point compared to 2022, reaching 21.08%, a comparative study of over 460,000 polling stations found no correlation between increased voter absence and reduced votes for the PT candidate.

item.title: Flávio pede que apoiadores tomem “um pouquinho de risco” nas redes
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro asked supporters to take risks on social media and boost mobilization for the second round, noting no one takes more risk than him. He called for renewed campaign activities and sharing of posts. The statement was made during a live stream amid the 2026 elections.

item.title: PCO orienta voto nulo para 2º turno entre Lula e Flávio
item.description: The PCO directs a blank vote for the 2nd round between Lula and Flávio, claiming neither represents the working class. Rui Costa Pimenta criticizes Lula's foreign policy, economic policy, and alliance with the STF.

item.title: Nunes Marques deve receber campanhas de Flávio e Lula nesta terça
item.description: TSE president Nunes Marques scheduled a meeting with the legal teams of Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula to discuss campaign judicialization. The meeting follows a judicial decision regarding the 'Exército do Lula' channel, which was suspended and later reinstated after intervention by the ombudsman.

item.title: TSE manda Flávio retirar vídeo que liga drogas a ato de Lula
item.description: TSE minister Marco Aurélio Bellizze ordered Flávio Bolsonaro, Pablo Marçal, and Carlos Bolsonaro to remove within 24 hours a post linking drug use images to Lula's support rally on Paulista Avenue, deeming the footage a 'serious manipulation through decontextualization' originally recorded in Chile. The ruling partially upheld a request from the Brazil Ready for More coalition backing Lula's reelection.

item.title: Flávio aciona TSE contra AGU por suposto uso de IA em vídeo pró-Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign filed a lawsuit with the TSE against Attorney General Jorge Messias over alleged AI use in a pro-Lula video. The case was assigned to Justice Marco Aurélio.

item.title: Multidões vão às ruas e STF e TSE só pensam em salvar seus próprios pescoços
item.description: STF and TSE became entangled in institutional disputes that prioritize ministers' personal interests over the electoral landscape. The suspension of 'Exército do Lula' triggered backlash benefiting the PT by exposing parallel operations and scandals like Master/Daniel Vorcaro. Flávio Bolsonaro and allies attempt to weaponize the judiciary against the PT but end up reinforcing persecution narratives and undermining institutions.

item.title: Kleber Mendonça elogia comercial sobre fim da 6 X 1: “Excelente filme”
item.description: Filmmaker Kleber Mendonça Filho praised a promotional video criticizing the 6 X 1 work schedule on social media, depicting the harsh reality of workers. The piece questions Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's stance on the proposal and highlights the upcoming vote on PEC 221/2019 in the Senate. The video emphasizes lost family time and emotional wear and tear from the reduced rest period.

item.title: TSE manda fórum sindical apagar posts contra Flávio
item.description: The TSE minister ordered Fonasefe to remove Instagram posts against Flávio Bolsonaro, deeming them irregular electoral propaganda on an institutional profile. The decision responds to a campaign request but does not ban new posts, leaving them for individual analysis. Fonasefe was accused of using its structure to encourage rejection of the candidate.

item.title: TSE manda Flávio Bolsonaro apagar vídeo enganoso sobre ato pró-Lula na Paulista; ministro vê 'grave manipulação'
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court ordered Flávio Bolsonaro and other lawmakers to remove misleading videos related to a pro-Lula event, containing manipulated images suggesting drug use by PT supporters. Minister Marco Aurélio Belizze labeled the action as 'serious manipulation' and demanded post removal within 24 hours.

item.title: TSE manda Flávio e aliados removerem vídeo falso sobre uso de cocaína por menina em ato pró-Lula
item.description: The TSE ordered Flávio Bolsonaro and allies to remove within 24 hours posts using decontextualized images linking Lula supporters to drug use. The decision aims to curb electoral disinformation ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: TSE manda Flávio e aliados apagarem vídeo falso sobre ato de Lula em SP
item.description: A Supreme Electoral Court minister ordered Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign to remove a false video misleadingly linking a young woman to pro-Lula demonstrations, citing manipulation by decontextualization. The ruling followed a lawsuit filed by the 'Brazil Ready to Go More' coalition, accusing Flávio and allies of spreading misinformation and irregular electoral advertising.

item.title: É #FAKE que vídeo de mulher com suposta substância ilícita seja de ato pró-Lula na Paulista
item.description: A false narrative links a video of drug use to a pro-Lula event on Paulista Avenue. The footage was circulating before the rally and there is no evidence confirming its origin or the identity of those involved.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro mira Tocantins para ampliar votação no 2º turno
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro plans to visit Tocantins to boost his vote in the second round, after winning the state in the first round with 50.44% of the votes. The campaign adopts caution to avoid complacency and prioritizes cities like Salvador and Porto Alegre, where Lula received more votes. Support for Dorinha Seabra and Vicentinho Júnior’s backing in the second round reinforce the strategy to consolidate the lead.

item.title: Apoiadores realizam ato pró-Lula em Copacabana sem a presença do presidente
item.description: Lula supporters held a rally in Copacabana without the president, who remained in Brasília. The mobilization included students, seniors, and PT and PSOL lawmakers, featuring speeches against amnesty and defending the vote in the runoff.

item.title: TSE diz que problema técnico deixou propaganda de Flávio sem som
item.description: The TSE reported that a technical issue in the Media Pool caused the audio failure in Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign ad aired during free electoral time. The problem was fixed before Lula's ad was shown, and Flávio's ad will be re-aired according to current electoral regulations.

item.title: Milei e Eduardo Bolsonaro participam do mesmo evento nos EUA na 4ª
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei and former federal congressman Eduardo Bolsonaro will participate in the Hispanic Heritage Gala in Washington D.C. on October 14, 2026, held 11 days before Brazil's presidential runoff. Milei, a guest of honor, will speak before Eduardo and has expressed support for Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy, emphasizing cooperation between Brazil and Argentina.

item.title: Milhares ocupam Copacabana em ato pela democracia e em apoio a Lula
item.description: Thousands of supporters filled the Copacabana shoreline in support of democracy and Luiz Inácio Lola da Silva's re-election, rallying on the holiday of Our Lady of Aparecida. Attendees emphasized the importance of voting and advocated for public policies in education, health, and equality, with participants of all ages, including young students and the elderly.

item.title: Autônomo ou CLT? Qual é o perfil atual dos trabalhadores com quem os candidatos estão falando
item.description: The profile of Brazilian workers has become more diverse, with significant growth in self-employed and autonomous workers, now representing about 25% of the workforce. While CLT employees remain the largest group (39 million), Lula's government policies still focus mainly on this category, such as minimum wage increases and IRPF exemption up to R$5,000. Candidates like Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula face the challenge of addressing demands from both traditional employees and entrepreneurs/autonomous workers in the 2026 electoral scenario.

item.title: Nunes Marques apontou descumprimento de acordo com TSE pela Meta ao derrubar ‘Exército do Lula’
item.description: The TSE minister suspends the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel for non-compliance with Meta's compliance plan; the suspension is overturned by the chief electoral officer, who deemed the restriction beyond mere plan oversight.

item.title: Campanha de Lula aciona TSE após post falso sobre comício na Paulista
item.description: Lula's campaign filed a lawsuit with the TSE demanding the removal of false posts linking old drug-related images to the Paulista Avenue rally. The PT accuses Flávio Bolsonaro's supporters of spreading disinformation and asks for fines against Meta and X if they fail to comply.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro participa de missa na Catedral de Brasília
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro attended a mass at the Cathedral of Brasília at the invitation of Cardinal Dom Paulo Cezar Costa, reinforcing his alliance with religious sectors. He celebrated the STF authorization to visit his father, Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest due to pneumonia. The candidate denied attempting to remove Our Lady of Aparecida from her status as Brazil's patron saint.

item.title: O chicote mudou de mãos e Nunes Marques faz no TSE ode a Moraes
item.description: TSE president Nunes Marques ordered the removal of Lula's WhatsApp channel using arguments akin to those once used by Bolsonarists, constituting prior restraint. Flávio Bolsonaro supported the decision while Lula criticized the TSE. The move reflects Alexandre de Moraes' legacy of expanding powers to combat electoral disinformation but raises concerns about free speech and judicial polarization.

item.title: SBT admite erro ao atribuir à EBC falha em propaganda eleitoral
item.description: SBT admitted an error in incorrectly attributing the audio failure in Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign ad to EBC, acknowledging the issue occurred during technical conversion. EBC and TSE clarified that the failure was part of a technical incident in the media pool affecting all broadcasters, with EBC only transmitting finalized content. SBT apologized for the misinformation.

item.title: Canal de Flávio faz associação falsa de cocaína a ato pró-Lula, e Tarcísio compartilha imagem
item.description: A WhatsApp channel linked to Flávio Bolsonaro's team (PL) shared a misleading image falsely associating a young woman appearing to use cocaine with the pro-Lula rally in São Paulo. The content was widely shared, including by Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (PL). Experts and officials criticized the misinformation, labeling it an attempt to discredit the PT.

item.title: Campanha de Lula não autorizou sobrevoo de drone para contagem de público na Paulista, dizem entidades
item.description: Organizations monitored Lula's campaign rally on Paulista Avenue but could not estimate the audience due to lack of drone authorization. Institutions linked to Cebrap, USP, and More in Common Brasil reported being denied permission to fly over the event.

item.title: Quaest no DF, 2º turno: Flávio Bolsonaro, 50%; Lula, 40%
item.description: A Quaest poll released on October 12 shows that in the Federal District, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leads with 50% against Lula (PT)'s 40% in the presidential runoff race, with 6% blank/null/none and 4% undecided. The survey interviewed 1,104 voters between October 8 and 11, with a margin of error of 3 percentage points.

item.title: Nunes Marques proíbe circulação de jornal sindical que compara propostas de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The president of the Brazilian Supreme Electoral Court (TSE), Kassio Nunes Marques, provisionally ordered the suspension of a union-published newspaper that compared the proposals of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro, following a lawsuit filed by Flávio's campaign. The decision was criticized by labor organizations, which labeled it censorship of free speech. The case will now be reviewed by the full court.
